description: Returns every third-party iframe (a booking, chat or payment widget, a video) this audit's pages embedded that tracked or loaded a Google container so far: the pages it was embedded in, the containers it loaded, the tracking it sent to its own accounts and to the site's, the events and consent commands in its own dataLayer, and the events it pushed that never reached the site's accounts. The page's tags can't read a widget's dataLayer, so those events only reach the widget's own tracking. Widgets' own hits are left out of the plan checks; finish_audit still checks them for consent and personal data.
name: get_widgets
title: List the embedded widgets seen so far
